lines.style: Speak fluent General American English in a very deep, low, booming bass voice, like a movie-trailer narrator: heavy and resonant, the pitch as low as possible. Native vowels, accurate stress, smooth linking. Quick: the whole line in about one second.

lines.text: What do you want to do about it?
lines.style: Speak fluent, casual General American English very fast, like a native talking to a friend: heavy linking and reductions ("whaddaya wanna do aboudit"), stress-timed rhythm, flapped t, no pauses, the whole line in about one second.
